## Validation

- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` when externally visible behavior changed

## Contract migration

If this changes a versioned contract, describe the coordinated protocol/schema/type/rule/prompt/example/renderer/documentation migration and compatibility behavior. Write “not applicable” only when no serialized or normative contract changes.
